notes.problem: Makes both father and daughter beauties, while kokushoku refers to the daughter alone.
notes.span: "Father and daughter, first beauties of the land, Tokyo people,"
notes.suggestion: "Father and daughter — she a peerless beauty — Tokyo people,"
notes.sureness: Fairly sure the plural number is wrong; kokushoku use elsewhere would settle it.

notes.japanese: これは私の親戚《しんせき》のもので、東条綱雄と申すものです。と善平に紹介《ひきあわ》されたる辰弥は
notes.problem: Dangling participle makes Tatsuya the kinsman presented, when Japanese introduces Tsunao to Tatsuya.
notes.span: Presented by Zenpei as "a kinsman of mine, Tojo Tsunao," Tatsuya greeted him
notes.suggestion: When Zenpei introduced him as "a kinsman of mine, Tojo Tsunao," Tatsuya greeted him
notes.sureness: Certain from syntax and story logic; no check needed beyond the sentence.

notes.japanese: 伯父様《おじさま》が用いて下さらねばそれまでのこと
notes.problem: Renders伯父様 as Oji-sama here while p69 and p71 use Uncle, breaking a consistent address term.
notes.span: if Oji-sama will not make use of them
notes.suggestion: if Uncle will not make use of them
notes.sureness: Certain about inconsistency from the English alone; passage wins over bible per instructions.

notes.japanese: 鋼雄は黙して俯向きぬ。 / 鋼雄は見もやらずなお口をつぐみぬ
notes.problem: Source twice prints steel-variant鋼雄 for綱雄; English silently normalises to Tsunao with no flag.
notes.span: Tsunao said nothing and hung his head.
notes.suggestion: Keep Tsunao in English but flag for editor to check 1895 text rather than silently normalise.
notes.sureness: Certain the characters differ in the source given; whether press slip needs editorial check.

notes.problem: Supplies verb 'fall' and completes a fragment the narrator leaves hanging.
notes.span: Tomorrow, upon whom shall it fall.
notes.suggestion: Tomorrow — whose — / Tomorrow, who is it to be.
notes.sureness: Fairly sure the incompleteness is deliberate withholding; checking final-line syntax would settle it.

data.say: The part is largely faithful and preserves key repetitions, with only the sense and consistency slips noted above.
